en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

Overseas user insights: Supported ZUS Coffee new-product research using user preferences, social engagement and competitor content to identify consumption occasions and product messages for launch and channel promotion.

Channel coordination and execution: Supported online launches and FamilyMart communications by organizing store information, promotional assets and schedules; helped deliver 50 Instagram posts through planning, shooting, editing and English copy.
Weekly reviews: Completed 15+ content reviews and adjusted subsequent topics and assets based on performance; contributed to 11k+ account follower growth during the project period.

Partner operations: Supported university and Southeast Asia AI education partnerships by clarifying requirements, trial arrangements and cooperation terms; prepared product introductions and proposals, and maintained a partner register of feedback, action items and milestones.

Agreement checks and risk identification: Checked parties, service scope, responsibilities and payment milestones in bilingual agreements; consolidated discrepancies and revisions, tracked version confirmation, and coordinated business and finance approvals, stamping and archiving.

Delivery follow-up: Supported demos, pilots and meetings by confirming participants, accounts and training materials; recorded owners and deadlines, coordinated product issues, and consolidated weekly progress and open tasks through resolution.
AI-assisted process improvement: Used AI to organize recurring partner follow-up and document preparation into SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.
Operations analysis and issue identification: Tracked core metrics and built an AI-assisted lightweight operations dashboard to identify user-journey drop-offs.

Partner resource screening: Screened finance and AI creators by audience profile, relevance and engagement; prepared campaign content, tracked publishing, and supported online promotion and offline technology events.

Product information and feedback: Organized feedback and pricing surveys to understand feature needs, willingness to pay and price acceptance, and planned outreach by usage stage; delivered 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts including introductions, tutorials and FAQs.

Strategy testing and review: Tested titles, covers and content and adjusted channel spending based on efficiency; registrations increased 50% versus the prior week during the campaign, while first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Partner follow-up, operational analysis and project coordination; working English and persistent issue follow-up.
Partner operations: requirements, product information, client registers, user issues and feedback.
Risk and delivery: agreement checks, payment milestones, handoffs, delivery tracking and cross-team issues.
AI: assisted dashboards, data analysis and document checks; SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Data: Excel, SPSS, SQL (basic); core metrics, user-journey analysis, A/B tests and reviews.
Content: Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Instagram; Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic).
